ABOUT THE AUTHOR

Betty Wakia

Researcher, writer, and author. BettyWakiaBlog is where her essays, research notes, and books come together — for readers who like their ideas considered and their writing unhurried.

Betty's work explores the intersections of culture, society, and human experience. Through her writing, she aims to make complex ideas accessible and to spark thoughtful conversations.

When she's not writing or conducting research, Betty can be found reading, exploring new places, or spending time with her community.
